name: overseer-wake
question: Is there anything in the airspace worth waking the LLM Overseer for? (the cheap deterministic mechanic of CSO's three-role split)
cost_provenance: measured 2026-07-20 on the ULDF framework repo under Git Bash (win32; slowest supported environment): 3 runs 1956-2089ms (mean ~2003ms). Aggregates four reads incl. a sibling concurrent-mutation oracle invocation (a subprocess), so it sits at/over the 2000ms fast-lane ceiling and grows with live sessions / shared repos -- honestly a slow-lane aggregator. Declared 2500ms carries headroom over measured. The prior 5000ms with lane:fast was a self-contradiction (>2000ms is a fast-lane violation, ORACLE-COST-01).

schema.wake: boolean (true when >=1 airspace signal warrants waking the LLM Overseer; fires only on positive evidence)

signals.detectorId: string -- a member of the CSO_CONTRACTS.md 1.1 detector registry: concurrent-mutation | shared-foreign-claim | stall-monitor | touches-conflict | resource-contention
signals.sessions: string[] (the sessionId(s) the signal involves; may be empty)

schema.briefing: string (empty when wake=false; one-liner suitable for ORACLE BRIEFING when wake=true -- the session-start hook prepends the [overseer-wake] tag)

fallback: Read .claude/collaboration/active-sessions.json: any sessions[] entry with status==active and a dead claudeShellPid is a stall/terminal signal. Run .claude/oracles/concurrent-mutation/run.sh and check external_mutation. Glob .claude/collaboration/*/file-tracking/touches.json for any file path claimed by >=2 distinct agents. Read .claude/collaboration/active-sessions.json again for >=2 active entries whose resourceClaim.resource strings match (live pid, unexpired boundUntil) -- that is resource contention. Any positive signal means the airspace has something worth the Overseer's attention. Absence of all sources is NO-DATA, never an all-clear -- do NOT assume the airspace is clean just because the oracle is unavailable.

provenance.note: CSO Phase 1, component C1 -- the cheap deterministic mechanic. PURE-SHELL aggregator over the five existing detectors (CSO-04 + CSO-21 resource-contention); NO LLM in this path. The cost defense (CSO-09): the LLM Overseer is woken ONLY when this oracle raises wake:true, never on a hot poll (the 15x multi-agent cost trap). Uses the CSO domain schema (wake/signals/summary) per the briefing-oracle convention (concurrent-mutation, stale-ltads-state, dispatchable-sessions) -- a domain schema plus a briefing field, NOT the generic status/details envelope. Read-only: run.{sh,ps1} never write. Graceful absence: a missing source is NO-DATA (omitted), never a fabricated all-clear; wake fires only on positive evidence.
